controls.label: Infrared color
controls.qualification: False color from its measured flux in three infrared bands (Stolker et al. (2025), arXiv:2507.06206; zero points from the SVO Filter Profile Service). The disc itself is unresolved; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere.
controls.notes: HD 135344 Ab's brightness in three infrared bands as one color: red SPHERE K2 2.253 µm, green SPHERE K1 2.102 µm, blue SPHERE H3 1.666 µm (Stolker et al. (2025), arXiv:2507.06206; zero points from the SVO Filter Profile Service), on a range shared with this planet alone, from zero to its brightest band (sphere k2), so the color shows its band ratios; brightness is not compared across planets at different distances. Not a natural color; nobody has resolved its disc. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret, Hauschildt & Witte (2012), A&A 546, A14 compute from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the K band at 1,510 K and log g 3.99 (u1 0.608, u2 0.042): a model, not a measurement of this planet.
